title: Keel Containment (keel/v1alpha1)
description: kind: Containment — the OS-sandbox backstop (spec section 5.2 runner). Declares, in terms the kernel can enforce, what the governed child CLI must NOT do regardless of PATH: file deletions matching a glob, writes outside the workspace, network. It compiles into the snapshot (so it is drift-detectable via the lock) and generates the platform sandbox profile. Rules with `tool:` validators keep living in the shim broker; this is the hard ring only.

denyUnlink.description: Globs whose matching files may not be deleted by the child (kernel file-write-unlink deny).

denyWriteOutside.description: Deny any write outside the workspace root (confinement).

denyNetwork.description: Deny outbound network for the child and its descendants.
